data.reason: Canonical rendering exceeded the 250000-byte Task evidence limit; reduce duplicated negative prose without changing requirements or design.

receipt.evidence: Actual native send_message queued the unchanged ten references plus exact correction digest while senior was completed; no wake occurred.

assumptions: No unconfirmed product fact is adopted as an assumption. Exact dependency versions, package provisioning, source-content classification and target-environment observations remain future constrained work; a material incompatibility returns the affected proposed design to review.
Qualified timing, graph size, fixture scales and D04 layout/debounce values remain evaluation targets rather than guaranteed or measured behavior.

differences.complementary: Architecture shipping/transaction/initializer findings are incorporated into the evidence candidate complete acceptance flow; the result is one 33-task draft with a dedicated launcher and common foundations before consumers.
differences.evidence: 347 records describes seven selected project/binding files; 412 describes the fully loaded canonical project including imports. Both are retained with their own locators/times. The process Capability is a source-inventory lead, not proof of sequence. Direct load is the only observed runtime-like planning result; future product verification remains unperformed.
differences.exclusive: No unresolved mutually exclusive core commitment remains. The unshippable dist target, digest-only partial-transaction acceptance, renderer-dependent List order and invented approval time are explicitly rejected in favor of the current updater, transaction and source-fidelity constraints. The candidate shared goals coexist under one bounded design.
differences.scope: Both cover the same full release. Eight evidence-oriented phases are retained, with granular manual/security/performance gates and explicit current initializer compatibility from architecture. Root adoption, retirement/deletion, installations, provenance maintenance and external actions remain separate exact authority gates.
differences.terminology: Service instance means one Python launch; reading session means one authenticated bootstrap exchange. Cursors bind to both, plus selected root/project/snapshot/query scope. The normalized relationship model drives both Map and List; List is independent of renderer availability. Module and endpoint names remain proposed.

interfaces: Dedicated Python read/session dispatcher with exact authenticated context/search/entry/relationships/neighborhood/source operations, narrow health and server-selected root; no generic execution or browser authority fields.

Non-creating observation of existing publication lock/intent/receipt/recovery state brackets immutable snapshot materialization and refuses active/unresolved selected-input transactions; stable pre/post digests alone cannot prove coherence.
HMAC cursors bind service instance, reading session, root/project, snapshot, normalized filters/query/direction/sort and key; stale context or restart invalidates continuation.

Selected identity plus registered snapshot reference governs source opens; fresh bounded no-follow bytes, exact verified locator or labeled excerpt, and recorded/current version distinction preserve evidence.

One shared API/state/route layer initiates reads; independent normalized relationship model/List precede renderer adapter. Shipping assets use explorer/assets; current initializer capability compatibility precedes legacy active-asset retirement.
omitted: CAND_EVIDENCE_V1 explorer/dist shipping target is replaced with explorer/assets/manifest.json and hashed runtime members because current Template discovery excludes dist/build. Build scratch remains private; exclusions are not loosened.

CAND_EVIDENCE_V1 late shared-state implementation and renderer-before-List dependency are replaced with foundation-first sequencing and renderer-independent List. Actual browser history and Map/List parity are retained in later integration gates.

CAND_ARCH_V1 combines accessibility/usability and security/nonmutation tasks; the proposal instead retains the evidence candidate separate bounded tasks so each required evidence gate has a clear owner. No required check is omitted.

CAND_ARCH_V1 observation-time decided_at for source approval is not adopted. All synthesized implementation decisions remain proposed with null decision timestamps; approved TRD revision/lifecycle/digest is retained as source provenance.

Future production/manual/performance/dependency/content observations are not represented as missing planning scope. Their unperformed status remains explicit in baseline limitations, proposed selection protocols and scheduled tasks under TRD D06/D08. No result or absent-source claim is invented.

V2 replaces repeated full acceptance prose in negative_requirements with concise negative obligations. The 49 requirement titles/outcomes, 119 exact acceptance sentences, dependencies, full scope, all tasks/coverage and chosen design remain byte-for-byte equal as parsed fields to V1; normalized canonical size now includes generated identity/history/validation in the bound check.
requirements: All 49 source requirement titles/outcomes, 119 exact acceptance sentences and requirement dependency lists remain unchanged; all AT-01 through AT-36 have explicit task verification mappings and no requirement is dispositioned away.
Forward/reverse source, requirement and task coverage is regenerated for the final task IDs; D01-D08 boundaries and all negative requirements remain represented.
retained: CAND_EVIDENCE_V1 supplies the complete 49-requirement/119-acceptance inventory, eight-phase release flow, granular security/offline/manual/nonmutation/performance/usability gates, separate Template/adoption/cutover/provenance work and honest delivery criteria.

CAND_ARCH_V1 supplies explicit shipping inventories and explorer/assets placement, updater dist/build exclusions, current initializer legacy-asset compatibility, partial-transaction snapshot refusal, precise source references, separate launch/health work, independent normalized List and final evidence-before-audit ordering.

Both candidates retain canonical semantics, semantic=False only for ordinary reader search, compact bounded projections, exact graph/source identity, thin Python read service, proposed TypeScript/Vite/Cytoscape choice, explicit action authority and all first-release exclusions.
risks: Publication interruption/lock races, oversized projections and cross-session/cross-project cursor replay have explicit adversarial fixture gates.

Updater exclusions, historical initializer compatibility, watcher coordination and mixed installed/source root copies constrain distribution and retirement; exact manifests and preservation checks remain mandatory.

Graph meaning, List accessibility, source freshness, manual environment availability and measured capacity remain explicit production acceptance risks; no synthetic/static evidence is promoted to live acceptance.
verification: Validate with the installed plan helper normalization, ephemeral identity/history preparation, structure and local source snapshot checks entirely in memory; no create or managed write is called.

Compare final title/outcome/acceptance/dependency arrays to exact TRD bytes, assert all36 explicit task AT references, planned-only tasks and empty evidence, verify executable ordering and common foundation dependencies, validate dispositions shape and current input digests.
